empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Existing source and generated engineering controls are preserved. No authentic model comparison, direct-observation trial, typed-viewer trial or human performance result is established for this registration.

113 independent worms or complete mutant/spontaneous scope from metadata subject labels.

disposition_reason: The source implements target-free role exports, train-only pair-mean/persistence/convolution references and complete held-worm scoring. Authentic trace extraction and independent worm/ROI/condition joins remain unresolved, so the numeric packet path is available only after externally verified custody; participant execution modes are not delivered.

scientific_target.question: Does a stimulated neuron’s measured calcium response improve prediction of a receiver’s complete measured post-stimulation trace in held worms beyond receiver prehistory and train-only pair/condition means?
scientific_target.known_answer: Receiver’s original measured fluorescence samples from 0 through 30 seconds relative to stimulation, with acquisition missingness retained; these measurements define prediction error, not a binary direct-synapse label.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Authentic noninterpolated/base calcium trace selected from the immutable NWB/source acquisition with verified ROI identity and native volume timestamps. Source units are n.a.; dF/F normalization cannot be assumed.
scientific_target.case_unit: One actual stimulation trial and source-to-receiver pair, retaining every original target timestamp and weak/nonresponse case.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Authenticated worm; all acquisitions and sessions from that worm stay in one role. DANDI’s 113 subject labels can be acquisition dates and are not 113 established animals.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective conditional reconstruction: source calcium includes -10 to +30 s while receiver context ends before 0. A causal convolution kernel in the baseline does not make the overall task pre-stimulus forecasting or prove direct connectivity.
exclusions: No synaptic-connectivity, direct-causality or pre-stimulus-forecasting claim from calcium prediction.
No substitution of published pooled response kernels, response-significant pairs or interpolated atlas traces for held measurements.
No paper-complete mutant/spontaneous coverage from hardcoded WT conversion metadata.

inputs: Source calcium at all original timestamps in [-10,30] s; receiver prehistory in [-10,0) s, with missing values retained.

Verified source/receiver identity, condition, stimulus duration/power and native onset; train-role target traces only. Requested held response_times_s are public, while held values and masks stay private.
forbidden_inputs: Held/development receiver responses, target-derived normalization, response-significance masks, quality flags or arbitrary evaluator metadata.
Published full-release pair kernels/significance summaries that include held worms, or stimulus metadata silently copied from unverified converter constants.
observation_contract.case_identity: Implemented normalized cases require case_id, worm_id, acquisition_id, trial_id, source_id, receiver_id and condition plus source asset/hash/ROI indices in custody. Public exports retain the identity fields and onset; an opaque target-safe alias map and exposure review remain necessary for protected participant use. Supplied identity_authenticated=true is an assertion, not an independent identity audit.
observation_contract.split: Implemented train/development/held roles require every worm in exactly one role and each acquisition in one worm. Kernel regularization is selected on separate development worms, with no refit of their responses into training. Authentic role assignment and full source identity map are not delivered.
observation_contract.coverage: Frozen expected_case_ids must exactly match all selected measured pairs/trials, including failures and weak/nonresponse records. Immutable release has 113 imaging and 110 segmentation assets; sub-20, sub-23 and sub-33 lack segmentation partners. Complete trace-only acquisition, OSF/genotype/spontaneous coverage and authentic worm census remain unresolved.

primary.name: Complete-held-worm mean candidate MSE minus train-only pair-mean MSE
primary.aggregation: Mean squared error over observed original samples per case; equal trials within condition/source/receiver pair; equal pairs within worm; equal held worms. Report every worm’s paired effect. A missing paired metric in any observed case suppresses the complete-roster mean and interval.
primary.rationale: Tests incremental conditional neural prediction beyond repeatable pair identity/stimulus structure without treating correlated pairs/trials as independent animals.

secondary: Raw model, pair-mean, receiver-persistence and convolution MSE; training-variance-normalized MSE and paired differences, undefined for missing/zero training variance.
Pearson correlation with explicit constant-trace outcomes.
Signed/absolute response-area error on adjacent valid samples within declared gap, with integrated duration and missing-tail coverage.

comparators.name: Training-only pair/condition mean
comparators.inputs: Training worms’ receiver traces for matching condition/source/receiver identity.
comparators.procedure: Implemented original-time interpolation only within supported adjacent samples and fixed max gap; average trials within worm then worms. Unseen/unsupported pairs retain undefined predictions instead of a favorable subset.

comparators.name: Receiver prehistory persistence
comparators.procedure: Implemented mean of valid prestimulus values predicts a flat poststimulus trace; no target centering.

comparators.name: Regularized source convolution
comparators.inputs: Same source trace and receiver prehistory; train-role targets.
comparators.procedure: Implemented prospective trapezoid lag grid [0,1,2,4] s and ridge grid [0.01,0.1,1], equal-worm fit, separate development selection without refit. These are new benchmark references, not reproduced author exponential kernels.

nuisance_controls: Implemented whole-source reassignment within animal/condition/source/stimulus/exact-clock groups; all receivers of one trial share the reassignment and unmatched singletons remain visible.
Stimulus/identity-only pair means and receiver-prehistory-only persistence; still require authentic identity permutation and synchronization-shift controls.
Check light artifacts, adjacent-cell stimulation and global calcium state; protect masks from effect-size selection.
Reconcile converter date-derived subject IDs, hardcoded WT, duration/power constants and zero/nonpositive ROI mapping against original acquisition records.
evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented prospective paired whole-worm percentile bootstrap: 2,000 draws, seed 0, 95% interval; fewer than two supported worms or incomplete paired support yields no complete-roster interval. Actual animal count/dependence and inferential adequacy require authentic identity review.
evaluation.failure_policy: Every held case and exact original target grid must appear once, with finite predictions even at missing-target positions and correct units. Missing/extra/duplicate/grid-invalid predictions fail. All-missing targets, unsupported references, absent tails and quality flags remain explicit; no favorable intersection or shorter horizon is substituted.

implementation.scorer_target: Numerically verifies held receiver-response prediction, train-only baselines and paired worm errors on a supplied custody packet. It is genuine conditional neural-response prediction, not source-table copying, but packet assertions cannot prove biological authenticity.
implementation.delivered_scope: NumPy source evaluator, train/development/held export allowlist, train-only references, source-reassignment control and generated tests. Filesystem ownership modes protect accidental export only; they are not participant isolation.

Verified original stimulus metadata, timestamps, units and independent missingness/quality policy.
Opaque participant identity policy, protected execution/exposure controls and matched direct/tool/program budgets.
implementation.execution_evidence: The documented tests use generated engineering data. Metadata and pinned converter/author source were inspected; no authentic trace/model run or scientific qualification is claimed.

direct_observation.boundary: No tools or receiver target values; source post-stimulus context is openly retrospective. Numeric export exists but no direct model transport or complete answer collector.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential typed dual-trace display of source response and receiver prehistory on native time axes.
typed_viewer.boundary: No target trace, target mask, pooled kernel or response-selected overview; any interpolation must be declared and must not replace raw samples.
missing: No typed trace viewer or image-only participant path is implemented.

tool_assisted.representation: Numerical per-case conditional response investigation using the exported trace schema and allowed train-role data.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same tools/checkpoints/input/compute within comparisons; no held/development score feedback; source export is available but adaptive execution is not enforced.
missing: Protected per-case numerical agent runtime, identity sanitization, tool logs and resource accounting.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted response-prediction code with training-only fit and fixed calibration/normalization.
frozen_program.boundary: Existing evaluator consumes predictions but does not bind their generating programme or train exposure. Freeze before held-worm access and preserve exact original time grids.
missing: Participant programme lifecycle, artifact provenance and authentic full-roster inference execution.

summary: Defines receiver measurement prediction as the known-answer endpoint while limiting interpretation to retrospective conditional response.
Promotes actual implemented sample/trial/pair/worm weighting, train-only normalization and unsupported-roster failure behavior into the current definition.
Separates target-free file export from participant isolation and identifies source identity/missing-segmentation limitations that prevent complete authentic delivery.
revision.source_review: Inspected original definition, evaluator validation/export/baseline/aggregation code, complete interface recipe, pinned upstream-source review and immutable release metadata. No signal downloads or model runs.
